notes.title: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate is officially out on Steam!
notes.notes:
1. We strongly recommending only romancing one character at a time for the best gameplay experience.
2. Saves from the Demo version won't transfer over to the official version.
3. The game supports Windows and Mac devices, but does not offer Steam Deck or controller support.
4. Bugs can be reported via the form found in [Option].

notes.title: Demo 2.0 is now out on Steam!
notes.notes:
- Added more plot & new characters
- Added three new gameplay functions: dating, texting, and items
- Improved the art, UI, and voice acting
- Edited parts of the script
We can't wait to hear what you think! Bugs can be reported via the "Options" page.
